text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Ruby, have you seen my tail
brush
anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No, at least not anywhere in the room.
Did you
lose it?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I haven't seen it since last night.
Thanks
anyway. I'm going to go look for
it real quick.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wahey! What's good Rubae? Like, it's
crazy rare
to see you 'round here! You
usually nyoom right
back to your room
after a bath.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
There's a brush I'm...
No, never mind. It's
nothing important. I'll be
taking my
leave now.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wait, come back! What's this
about a brush
now?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Are you looking for one? 'Cause it kinda
seems
that way to me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, count me in! Can't keep letting
you wear
that frown! C'mon!
Waheeey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Miracle, would it be difficult for you to
procure
another brush like the one
you're searching for?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hm? Nah, I guess it wouldn't.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(...Looks like there are quite a few
results for the
particular brush Miracle
told me about. It's a
rather common and
low-price brand.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Proper tail care and maintenance is
crucial for
racers like us. Neglecting it
could affect one's
balance and,
consequently, one's performance.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(If she doesn't manage to find her brush
soon, she
won't be able to care for her
tail for who knows
how long...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(As a person of my stature and
background,
there's but one thing I must
do.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One morning, I spot Daiichi Ruby and
K.S.Miracle
on their way to school.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Um, Miracle—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Mornin', Rubae! ☆ Check it out—is this
that brush
you were looking for?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Brush? Sorry to interrupt, but could I
take a
look?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wait, this is my brush!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I've been looking all over!
I'm so glad
you found it...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
When I was discharged from the
hospital, the
children who were also
there for treatment
pooled together
their pocket money to buy this
for me...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For reals?! That's so peak of them! All
that
searching was so worth it, then!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
But wait. Hang on! I thought the brush
was yours,
Rubae! Wasn't that why you
were looking for it?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No, I was merely a little concerned
about its
disappearance. All the same, I
thank you for your
help.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aw, well... Miracle's happy, and you're
happy, so I
guess that means I'm all G
too! Glad everything
worked out!
Laters! ☆

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You were looking for my brush too?
Thank you.
By the way, what were you
going to say earlier?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: It was nothing of particular importance.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? You know you can be
open with
me, Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It's really nothing, I assure you. But,
well...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I simply happened to purchase this
brush, is all.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
But I see now that I was being too hasty,
so don't
pay it any mind. I'll dispose of it
in my own time.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hold on. This might sound greedy of me,
but
could I have that too?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! I'll make good use
of it, I
promise.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I'm glad.
